description: How much you can still spend right now, before you pay: your API key's remaining today and per-request cap, and your wallet allowance's remaining today, per-purchase cap and approval on Base or Solana, each with spendableNowUsd and bindingLimit (the limit that would refuse a larger call). Owner can pause (Emergency stop) or Revoke the allowance: Base AgentAllowance is on-chain; Solana daily and per-purchase limits are server-checked. Read-only: it cannot change a limit. Free, but needs your API key.
name: get_allowance
title: Get allowance
